pr_title: Fix buying power error handling bug in BacktestingBrokerage
pr_body:
#### Description
A missing `continue` statement in `BacktestingBrokerage` was causing orders rejected for insufficient buying power to have an incorrect order status.  Depending on the algorithm, the correct `OrderStatus.Invalid` was overwritten with `OrderStatus.New` or `OrderStatus.CancelPending`.

#### Related Issue
Fixes #1843

#### Motivation and Context
Algorithms calling `Transactions.CancelOpenOrders` frequently were reporting orders with a status of `OrderStatus.CancelPending` instead of `OrderStatus.Invalid`.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
A new `CancelOpenOrdersRegressionAlgorithm` regression test is included.

#### Types of changes
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/ect)

#### Checklist:
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [x] I have read the **CONTRIBUTING** [document](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [x] All new and existing tests passed.
- [x] My branch follows the naming convention `bug-<issue#>-<description` or `feature-<issue#>-<description>`
